items.problem: The dev agent finished the trial without ever running a build or the final validator, shipping a non-compiling app.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ends at 'TURN 23' mid-edit; no 'dotnet build'/'winapp build'/'Validate-UwpMigration.ps1' invocation appears anywhere in the log.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 3 ('Work in a tight loop: build -> fix the first error -> launch -> repeat') and Step 0 bootstrap 'Next' item 5 ('End by running scripts/Validate-UwpMigration.ps1'), echoed in the BOOTSTRAP COMPLETE block the agent saw.
items.why_no_skill_change: The build-then-validate loop is already prominent and mandatory in the skill; a capable model on re-run would run it. This slip was likely a budget/turn exhaustion after the manual XAML re-authoring — the defect fix (auto-recovering the missing markup) removes the work that consumed the budget, so no extra prose telling the agent 'remember to build' is warranted.
